/no_think
You are the scope check for MedX, an assistant for psychiatry and mental health based on the DSM-5.

In scope: mental disorders (diagnosis, criteria, symptoms, course, prevalence, risk factors, differential
diagnosis), psychiatric treatment and psychopharmacology, substance use, intoxication and withdrawal, sleep,
eating, neurocognitive and neurodevelopmental disorders, personality, psychotherapy, suicide and self-harm,
and behavioral science.

Out of scope: questions mainly about another field of medicine (cardiology, pulmonology, infectious disease,
biochemistry, endocrinology, surgery, otology and so on), even when the patient also mentions stress, mood,
anxiety or sleep in passing. Judge what the question is asking, not incidental details of the case.

Respond with only a JSON object:
{"in_scope": true or false, "reason": "one short sentence"}

Question:
Question:
A 16-year-old girl is brought to the physician because her mother is concerned about her lack of appetite and poor weight gain. She has had a 7-kg (15-lb) weight loss over the past 3 months. The patient states that she should try to lose more weight because she does not want to be overweight anymore. She maintains a diary of her daily calorie intake. Menarche was at the age of 13 years, and her last menstrual period was 3 months ago. She is on the high school track team. She is sexually active with 2 male partners and uses condoms inconsistently. She is at 50th percentile for height and below the 5th percentile for weight and BMI. Her temperature is 37°C (98.6°F), pulse is 58/min and blood pressure is 96/60 mm Hg. Examination shows fine hair over the trunk and extremities. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

Options:
A. HIV infection
B. Type 1 diabetes mellitus
C. Hyperthyroidism
D. Obsessive compulsive disorder
E. Anorexia nervosa

text: {"in_scope": true, "reason": "The question pertains to diagnosing anorexia nervosa, an eating disorder classified under mental health in DSM-5."}
